article.headline: Korea Box Office: Anime Sensation ‘Chiikawa’ Dominates Weekend
article.summary: Japanese animated phenomenon “Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island” tightened its grip on the South Korean box office over the weekend of Oct. 16–18, commanding more than 42% of nationwide ticket revenue in its third frame.
